title.text: AI SEO companies and published evidence

narration.text: Searchbloom lists Searchbloom, The SEO Works, Tinuiti, Graphite, and iPullRank as the best AI SEO companies in 2026.
AI SEO mostly involves traditional SEO work, but now adds measuring AI visibility and citations from external pages.

Traditional SEO plus AI visibility measurement

scenes.visual_direction: Arrange company names as plain text cards beside the AI SEO explanation; reveal the AI visibility measurement item as the narration moves to that topic. Use only the cited on-screen items, without logos or endorsement symbols.

narration.text: Searchbloom lists AI visibility, brand presence on external pages, technical and structured-data foundations, content and entity authority, and documented results as scoring criteria.

on_screen.text: AI visibility and external citations
Technical foundation and content authority

scenes.visual_direction: Show a checklist of the cited AI visibility, external-page, technical, content, and results criteria; highlight each row as it is narrated, without assigning weights or scores.

narration.text: Searchbloom reports measuring 68,631 AI answers in its category, with its own website cited 8.9% of the time.
Searchbloom says the best AI SEO company manages SEO work, measures AI visibility daily, and identifies outside pages worth earning.
PR, social, sponsorships, and partner listings remain with the client's own team.

scenes.visual_direction: Arrange the cited AI answer count and website citation percentage as static tiles; connect them to a conceptual SEO-work and outside-page layout, with a separate client-team area. Use no fabricated dashboard readings or trend lines.

narration.text: Searchbloom ranks itself as the best overall AI SEO company in 2026 based on published methods and results.
Searchbloom reports a custom closet company's search leads rose 122% in a year.
That company's CRM recorded 20 of its 51 September 2026 leads as coming from AI search.
In Searchbloom's ranking, the company scored 48 out of 50 for AI search tied to leads and revenue.

scenes.visual_direction: Display the self-ranking disclosure above static search-lead and score tiles; reveal the cited client result alongside the CRM lead counts as they are narrated. Keep publisher attribution visible, with no award badge, logo, or invented time series.

narration.text: In Searchbloom's ranking, The SEO Works placed second with 44 out of 50 for specialist SEO and AI SEO partnerships, starting at GBP 1,500 a month.
Searchbloom ranks Tinuiti third with 44 out of 50 for AI search within full-funnel media engagements; fees are not published.

scenes.visual_direction: Split the layout into The SEO Works and Tinuiti columns; reveal the cited price and specialty items alongside their narration, preserving GBP and the unpublished-fee status. Use text and simple layout shapes, not assumed company assets.

title.text: Graphite and iPullRank strengths and terms

narration.text: Searchbloom ranks Graphite fourth with 42 out of 50 for AEO and SEO grounded in original research, with unpublished fees and a 12-month minimum SEO term.
Searchbloom ranks iPullRank fifth with 41 out of 50 for relevance engineering and technical AI search work; fees, minimums, and terms are not published.

on_screen.text: Graphite: AEO/SEO grounded in original research
iPullRank: relevance engineering and technical AI search

scenes.visual_direction: Arrange Graphite and iPullRank in parallel text columns; highlight the cited research and technical-work items, then their narrated contract and disclosure terms. Use no logos or award symbols.

narration.text: Only three companies publish a price: Searchbloom starts SEO at $3,000 a month with no lengthy contracts, The SEO Works starts at GBP 1,500 a month, and Siege Media’s minimum is $8,000 a month.
Searchbloom says AI SEO priced at a few hundred dollars a month likely produces automated content flagged by Google's spam policies.
The SEO Works and Siege Media publish all key transparency items, while Searchbloom publishes all but minimums beyond starting fees.
Eight of the nine companies publish dated AI search results, and all nine say how they track AI visibility.
